Troubleshooting · 44/50 · delivery

Upload completed incompletely

Failure signal

A upload completed incompletely condition is reported or detected during delivery.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for delivery does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare remote byte counts and hashes with the signed local manifest.

Corrective action

Resume or repeat only failed objects, then verify the entire remote set.

Prevention

Add this verification to the delivery gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
